whatThisIs: [GBLS (Greater Boston Legal Services ) offers free legal services to low-income individuals in the greater Boston area who can not afford to hire private legal services. They offer their services if there is a demonstrated need for legal services in housing, un-safe job conditions, immigration assistance, and protection from domestic violence.]
whoItHelps: Individuals who need assistance Immigration Law

Individuals who need assistance with housing dispute such as unsafe housing or rent disputes
Individuals who need assistance with workers rights
